name: three-happy-kids-monorepo
description: Monorepo de Three Happy Kids: frontend, API Gateway y servicios backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend/services/users-service install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.verify:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:api && npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:users && npm run verify:frontend
